author: PBS Space Time
description:
How many times can you cut a distance in half before you reach the smallest possible scale of space? After just 115 halvings, we reach the Planck length, where spacetime may become a quantum realm of fluctuations, virtual black holes, and wormholes, the realm where our understanding of physics breaks down.
